text: You turn 40. A card says you're "not old, just vintage", above a wine bottle with legs. You keep it, and you hate it.

up.label: Run a marathon on the day

risk.result: You hit the wall at mile eleven and stay there.

death.cause: The heart gave out at mile eighteen.

text: There's a red convertible in the showroom window, leather seats warm in the sun. It knows your name. It knows your year.

right.label: Buy it
right.result: It rains for the next five months.

up.label: Quit the job and drive across the continent

risk.result: You find yourself. You don't find a job.

text: The menu has got smaller. All menus have got smaller. You hold this one at arm's length while the waiter waits.

up.label: Take up the violin

risk.result: The neighbours leave a note. Then another.

text: Your knee now predicts the weather, more accurately than the forecast. It clicks on the stairs. It says rain Thursday.

up.label: Take up fell running instead

risk.result: Surgery. Both knees.

text: A letter invites you for a routine screening. It's printed in a very calm font. It uses the word "just" four times.

risk.result: They find it later than they should have. The treatment is hard.

right.label: Go
right.result: All clear. You treat yourself to a sandwich.

up.label: Pay for the private full-body scan

risk.result: They find three odd shadows. All benign. After three weeks.

text: The nurse pumps the cuff twice, frowns at the dial, and asks about your week. You say "fine". The dial disagrees.

right.label: Cut the salt and walk more

up.label: Go vegetarian and take up swimming

risk.result: You are tiresome at dinner parties.

text: Your chest feels tight on the stairs. Your left arm is heavy, like it's carrying shopping. Probably nothing.

death.cause: a heart attack on the stairs

risk.result: You wake up in a hospital with a stent.

right.label: Go to the ER
right.result: They catch it in time. A doctor uses the phrase "wake-up call".

up.label: Call an ambulance and cancel everything

risk.result: It was heartburn. The paramedic is polite.

text: A parent has started repeating the same story, the one about the goat at the wedding. That's three times this visit.

up.label: Record every story on video

risk.result: It is a lot of footage. They are a lot of stories.

text: A parent can't manage alone any more. The kettle was left on twice this week. The care home brochure smiles a lot.

up.label: Move abroad together to somewhere warm

risk.result: Healthcare abroad is another story.

text: The funeral's on Friday. The sandwiches are ordered. Somebody needs to say a few words, and everybody looks at you.

right.label: Say them
right.result: You get through it. Then you find their handwriting on a shopping list.

up.label: Read their favourite poem and sing

risk.result: You break down mid-verse. No one blames you. You do.

text: A friend from your twenties died. You find out from a post, wedged between a sock advert and a skateboarding dog.

right.label: Call the old group

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

right.result: You promise to meet more than at funerals.

up.label: Organise a memorial weekend

risk.result: Old grudges came too.

text: The promotion went to someone born the year you started working. They have great hair and call everyone "legend".

up.label: Go into business with your rival

risk.result: They steal the client list and leave.

text: HR invites you to a meeting about "exciting changes". You walk in. There's a box of tissues on the table.

risk.result: You keep the job. You lose your desk, your team and your window.

up.label: Take the payout and start your own firm

risk.result: Year one is fine. Year two is not.

text: Work has a new system. The twenty-three-year-old explaining it speaks gently, the way you'd talk to a nervous horse.

up.label: Build your own tool instead

risk.result: Nobody uses it. It is very elegant.

text: Your pension statement has arrived. The graph is not a nice shape. It's a ski slope, and you're at the bottom.

up.label: Move it all into property

risk.result: The market turns. So does your stomach.

text: A man on the radio says it isn't too late to get rich. He sounds very tanned. His seminar costs two thousand.

risk.result: You paid for it later.
The main lesson is to run seminars.

up.label: Write your own seminar

risk.result: Four people come. Two are your cousins.

text: A doctor says you need more exercise. The local pool has a slow lane, chlorine fumes and three very fast pensioners.

right.label: Join the slow lane
right.result: Everyone in it has opinions about the fast lane.

up.label: Train for a channel swim

risk.result: The water is much colder than the pool.

death.cause: The sea took you, quietly, halfway across.

text: You've got your weekends back. There's a Saturday choir, or a shed at the end of the garden with a good chair.

right.label: The choir
right.result: You're told to mime the high bits.

up.label: Found your own club

risk.result: Every committee ends in a feud.

text: Your school bully sends a friend request. They've found peace, a beard and a podcast, and want to talk about all three.

right.label: Hear them out
right.result: They don't remember the thing you've remembered for thirty years.

up.label: Host a reconciliation dinner

risk.result: It was a very long dinner.

text: A local college wants mentors in your line of work. One hour a week, free coffee, and students who think you're ancient.

up.label: Start a scholarship in your name

risk.result: The paperwork consumes a year.

text: You've gone up a size. The jeans are winning. The shop assistant smiles kindly and calls the next size "relaxed fit".

up.label: Hire a trainer and do the programme

risk.result: The trainer is lovely. The programme is evil.

text: Your hairline has moved out without telling you. No forwarding address. The wind now reaches new parts of your head.

risk.result: It comes back in a straight line. People look at it.

up.label: Shave it and grow a magnificent beard

risk.result: The beard comes in grey and patchy.

text: A clinic promises to take ten years off your face. The photos look great. Your face would have to stay very still.

risk.result: You look permanently surprised, which is at least honest.

up.label: Go for the full makeover

risk.result: Your face has made a decision without you.

text: You could retrain and do what you wanted to do at twenty. You kept the notebook of plans. Everyone says you're mad.

up.label: Sell the house and go back to college

risk.result: You're the oldest on the course. By far.

text: A distant aunt you met twice has left you some money. And a lot of spoons. Four hundred and twelve of them.

up.label: Open a spoon museum

risk.result: It becomes a local tourist trap.

text: You're invited to a party that starts at nine. At night. You're usually asleep by then, with a hot water bottle.

right.label: Go
right.result: You leave at ten and feel wonderful about it.

up.label: Host your own, and finish it at dawn

risk.result: You're not 25. Your body knows.

text: The doctor asks how much you drink. You halve it. The doctor, who has heard this before, doubles it and writes it down.

up.label: Check into rehab for a month

risk.result: The bills arrive faster than the recovery.

text: You're awake at 4am again, staring at the ceiling, replaying something you said in 1998. Nobody else remembers it.

up.label: Get up and start the novel

risk.result: It's still bad. You're still tired.

text: Someone young is crying at the bus stop, and pretending not to. They're staring very hard at the timetable.

right.label: Ask if they're all right
right.result: They're fine. They tell you anyway, and the bus comes twice.

up.label: Take them for a coffee and stay all day

risk.result: They turn out to be a lot. You miss a meeting.

text: You've started counting the years to retirement. You have an app for it, with a progress bar. It moves very slowly.

right.label: Check it at lunch
right.result: It has a little countdown, and a confetti setting.

up.label: Cash out and run a b&b

risk.result: Guests are a different species.
